title: Fugue
note: Hand-authored for games/fugue (the one-player suites the gate can drive at real speed: the timed multiplayer set is replayed by tests/fugue_rules.mjs instead). The gate reads this file.
rules: Three or more players. Every round one player is the CONNECTIONIST and the rest are STREAMERS. Each streamer has their own secret prompt and must lock a word every 3 seconds (type it, hit space - like an email address turning into a bubble). The host picks the flavor of the set: Classic holds one relation for the whole round; Full Fugue snaps to a new relation after every link; Free Association deals no relation and any link stands if the streamers vote it through (not available solo). The connectionist sees every locked word and forges links, one word from each of two or more streams. Straight vertical links and links reaching more streams score more. Streamers score too: 1 point per locked word, and 4 points for a word blessed by a standing link (a #blessed flash marks it at the tally). A streamer may swap their prompt once per round during live for 3 points; locked words carry over. Linked words stay in the grid at low opacity; a column with every stream full of linked words collapses to a sliver. Afterwards the streamers vote on every link. Everyone takes a turn connecting, then the set is compared. On a one-player table the lobby offers two solo modes: Stream (timed word locking from a prompt) and Connect (three books, drawn from the bank baked by scripts/bake-fugue-words.py, drip words; the player is the connectionist and every link stands unjudged).
